row:
Welcome to Zoo Ost - the channel for all things osteopathic. Created by multi award winning osteopath Tony Nevin. Join us as we use osteopathy to treat some of the planets most iconic creatures, including humans! With more than 300 species already treated there will be plenty of variety. Zoo Ost are true pioneers.
People and animals evolved from the same star dust. They share the same conditions and ailments, and are subject to the same laws of physics. Where possible we will use technology to help you see more of what we do.
Our videos aim to be useful, educational and information packed. They are also entertaining, especially when something doesn't go to plan!
We film during real clinics and treatments. We don't stage events. Editing is used just to tidy things up and make for a more pleasant viewing experience.
Please check out our blog page - listed in the links, and join us on this exciting journey of discovery.
